# PROCESS — cand_0003 (iteration 3)

## Ranked clusters (trajectories of cand_0002; 35 trials)
| rank | cluster | tasks / trials | root cause | tag | lever |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | C. Several reservations booked by parallel book_reservation calls | 23 t0, t2 (all 3 bookings correct but run in random order → reservation ids differ from gold → DB mismatch); 23 t4 also had destination=JFK for round trip JFK→SFO | proxy runs parallel calls in an unpredictable order; agent can't control it | CAPABILITY-GAP | NEW composite `book_reservations_in_order` (validates all, then books sequentially in list order, shared-balance check); book_reservation doc + 1-cert error point to it; round_trip destination==origin guard |
| 2 | A. Insurance-only cancellation with an uncovered reason | 44 t0 (KC18K6 cancelled, reason "change of plans"), t2 & t4 (S61CZX cancelled, reason never asked) | cancel guard accepted "has insurance" as a ground since it cannot see the reason | DECISION (narrow) | guard in cancel_reservation: when insurance is the ONLY ground, refuse and route to NEW `cancel_reservation_with_insurance(reservation_id, reason)` which refuses explicit non-covered reasons (change of plans, trip length, not health…) |
| 3 | B. 44 upgrade misreads | 44 t0/t2 "basic economy cannot be upgraded"; t4 KC18K6 excluded by adding the layover; t1–t3 WUNA5K quote fails with "not found" (already flown), invented UA1234/DL123 | knowledge + poor error | KNOWLEDGE + enriched return | get_reservation_flight_times returns per-flight status, `longest_flight_hours_overall`, `any_flight_flown`, `cabin_upgrade` + worked example of the per-flight rule; calculate_flight_change_cost error says "already flown" / lists current flights; docs: basic economy CAN be upgraded |
| 4 | D. nonfree_baggages ignores membership | 20 t0 (gold member, 3 economy bags marked 2 nonfree → $100 overcharge) | agent assumed 1 free bag | RULE | computation in book_reservation: allowance from policy table; too-high nonfree corrected and the overcharge taken off the card |
| 5 | E. Same-day double booking reasoning | 42 t1 (cancelled HTR26G, missed 5BGGWZ), t4 (gave up → transfer) | agent juggles 7 reservations by hand | CAPABILITY-GAP (loop) | NEW read-only `find_same_day_reservations` (groups the day's legs per reservation, return legs on their own date, only_account_holder flag, step-by-step keep/cancel rule) |
| — | 35 t4 total_baggages=1 for "no baggage" | 35 t4 | knowledge; no safe predicate (gold has total = allowance with nonfree 0 in 20) | — | skipped (doc already exists) |
| — | 23 t1/t3 picked the costlier option (upgrade / old flights) | 23 | miscomputed comparison | — | skipped (no bounded code fix found this iteration) |

## Edits
| id | file | type | blast radius |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| E1 | NEW book_reservations_in_order.py | composite sequential write (embeds book_reservation's full rule set as nested helper; dry-run all first; cumulative certificate/gift-card balance check) | new tool, only chosen for ≥2 bookings; 8 (single booking) unaffected |
| E2 | book_reservation.py | doc: ≥2 reservations → composite; 1-certificate error mentions the composite | additive; single bookings unchanged |
| E3 | book_reservation.py | guard: round_trip with destination == origin → Error | BOUNDED; 10/10 gold books pass |
| E4 | book_reservation.py | computation: membership × cabin free bag allowance; too-high nonfree corrected, overcharge removed from credit card → gift card → certificate, note with final split | BOUNDED: fires only when nonfree > max(0, total − allowance); 10/10 gold books unaltered |
| E5 | cancel_reservation.py | guard: insurance is the only ground → Error with next step | MODERATE: changes the path only for insurance-only cancels. Val passing tasks 8/10 never cancel. Non-val gold (7, 19, 29, 39) now need one extra call; their reasons pass E6 |
| E6 | NEW cancel_reservation_with_insurance.py | reason-checked cancel (deny explicit uncovered reasons; health/weather words override unless negated; unknown reasons allowed) | only reached via E5 |
| E7 | get_reservation_flight_times.py | enriched return (status, longest_flight_hours_overall, any_flight_flown, cabin_upgrade) + per-flight rule with worked example | read-only |
| E8 | calculate_flight_change_cost.py | enriched errors (already flown; list current flights); doc: basic economy CAN be upgraded | read-only; success path unchanged |
| E9 | update_reservation_flights.py | doc: basic economy CAN be upgraded | additive; guards unchanged |
| E10 | NEW find_same_day_reservations.py | read-only loop/compute tool | read-only, new |

## Verify-the-fix (local harness /tmp/ce: tool files exec'd with env_* bound to tau2 AirlineTools on db.json)
- E1: 23 gold's 3 bookings via composite after cancelling K1NW8N → "booked HATHAT, HATHAU, HATHAV" and final DB == gold DB. 2 certs in item #2 → error, 0 booked. Same certificate in 2 items → shared-balance error, 0 booked.
- E3: 23 t4 args (round_trip JFK→JFK) → Error; 10/10 gold books → ok.
- E4: 20 t0 args (cert 250 + card 105, nonfree 2, gold member, 3 bags) → booked cert 250 + card 5, nonfree 0 (== gold). 10/10 gold books → "ok" (no notes).
- E5/E6: KC18K6 "change of plans" → refused; S61CZX "change of plans - not health related" / "flights longer than 4 hours" → refused; S61CZX "I am sick" → cancelled; task 7 59XX6W "I'm sick", 19 Z7GOZK "I feel unwell", 39 MSJ4OA "give up my seat for someone else" → cancelled; empty reason → asks. Non-insurance grounds unchanged: FDZ0T5, HSR97W, K1NW8N, 8C8K4E, LU15PA cancel; M20IZO, XEHM4B refused.
- E7: KC18K6 → longest_flight_hours_overall 3.0 (legs 3.0/2.0); S61CZX 5.5; WUNA5K any_flight_flown true, cabin_upgrade "no"; NM1VX1/H8Q05L cabin_upgrade "yes: basic_economy can be upgraded".
- E8: WUNA5K quote → "already been flown (status: landed)"; UA1234 → error lists HAT271/HAT197; KC18K6 business quote → 740.
- E10: sophia_martin_4574 → May 17: SE9KEL (other pax), FDZ0T5 (JFK→PHL), 5BGGWZ (return DFW→EWR); May 22: PUNERT (BOS→DEN), HSR97W (ORD→SFO). Steps give keep 5BGGWZ+PUNERT, cancel FDZ0T5+HSR97W == gold.
- Gold replay: 20/20 update_reservation_flights not blocked; 10/10 book_reservation unaltered. All 20 files: one top-level def named like the file; SKILL.md empty; primitive_tools untouched.

## Skipped
- 35 t4 total_baggages for "no baggage": no predicate separates it from gold 20 (total == allowance, nonfree 0).
- 23 t1/t3 cost comparison of upgrade vs cancel+rebook: would need a new compare tool; not built (time), noted for next run.
- Removing raw cancel_reservation: not done; the frozen seed tool stays and routes to the new tool.

## Process
- Serial diagnosis of all 35 trials with a compact dumper (/tmp/ce/d3.py), gold args and db.json. No subagents (7 tasks). The composite was generated from book_reservation.py's body so both share one rule set (generator: /tmp/ce/gen_multi.py; re-run it if book_reservation changes).

## Preserve
- All guards and tools from iterations 1–2.
